description: Make the Aero Hand assembly animations and diagrams viewable inside Helping Hands. Everything from the build session is saved under third_party/aero_hand/guide: the 3D page-41 thumb cable animation (anim41.html, with real left-hand CAD), the page-32 demos, LEGO-style real-photo diagrams, the join photo, the marks table and the per-page viewers. Build a gallery/index Jake can open from his phone and the projector, with every animation listed by guide page, plus a button that opens the assembly PDF (aero_guide_original.pdf). Pages p*.png are regenerated by render_pages.py.

user_request.name: put all these animations and things we built into helping hands in a way that I could see them... add a button to helping Helping hands. I'm to view that PDF.

summary: Aero Hand assembly animations and diagrams saved in third_party/aero_hand/guide aren't yet viewable inside Helping Hands. Build a phone- and projector-friendly gallery index listing every animation by guide page, with a button opening aero_guide_original.pdf.
